title: VectorDbRow
description: Design proposal, not yet implemented (Phase 12). Describes the logical shape of one row in a future Vector DB table (e.g. Postgres/pgvector's 'embeddings_<dimension>' table -- see vector_db_design.md §5). This is the payload stored ALONGSIDE the vector, not the vector itself (see 'embedding' below for how the vector is referenced). Every non-vector field here is either reused verbatim from embedding_manifest.schema.json's EmbeddingRecord or is a plain SQL filter/status column -- nothing invented beyond what vector_db_design.md §6 justifies.

FilterMetadata.description: Reused verbatim from embedding_manifest.schema.json's EmbeddingRecord.filter_metadata -- never re-derived, never extended with fields that don't already exist on the source chunk (see vector_db_design.md §6.B).

RowStatus.description: 'stale' when the source chunk_id no longer exists in the current knowledge_chunks.json at the time of the last import -- the row is KEPT (never deleted), matching embedding_manifest.schema.json's own EmbeddingRecord.status convention one layer up (see vector_db_design.md §7).

VectorDbRow.description: One row of a dimension-specific table (e.g. embeddings_1024 -- see vector_db_design.md §5 for why the table split is by DIMENSION, not by chapter or model name). row.embedding's length must equal that table's fixed dimension.

embedding_id.description: Primary key. Reused verbatim from embedding_manifest.schema.json's EmbeddingRecord.embedding_id -- never regenerated or reformatted at import time.

chunk_id.description: FK to knowledge_chunks.json's own chunk_id. The Vector DB is NOT the authoritative source of chunk content -- callers resolve chunk_id back to that file for the actual text/figure_refs/related_chunk_ids (see vector_db_design.md §6.C).

embedding_model.description: e.g. 'BAAI/bge-m3' -- reused verbatim from the manifest, never a friendly label.

model_revision.description: Exact model revision/commit -- reused verbatim from the manifest.

content_hash.description: Reused verbatim from the embedding record -- the identity/drift-detection key for synchronization (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE WHERE content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM ...). Never compared via vector floating-point equality (see vector_db_design.md §7).

created_at.description: From the embedding record -- when the vector was originally computed.

imported_at.description: When this row was last inserted/updated in the Vector DB -- distinct from created_at, used to audit synchronization runs (see vector_db_design.md §12).

embedding.description: The stored vector itself (e.g. Postgres 'vector(1024)'). Length is fixed per table/dimension -- a row belongs in exactly one dimension-specific table, never split across tables (see vector_db_design.md §8).
